strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: yikuwoneseska bokosi la kiyi ilo lilipo sonosono apa na mndandanda wa Google wakufumiskikapo (CRL) ndipo yikuyezga magwero ghanandi m’paka yisange bokosi la kiyi lakuzomerezgeka, na backup yakujiyimira payokha na kuyambiskaso ntchito za Google. Kuthamanga pa mpopi yiliyose ndipo kukukhumba intaneti (mphindi 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Bokosi la kiyi kufuma ku netiweki: likutora bokosi la kiyi kufuma ku malo ghakusungirako vinthu ghakuzomerezgeka (GitHub) na kulisunga ku /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Likukhumba intaneti ndipo likutora mphindi 1-3. Kugwiriskira ncito para smart fetch yatondeka panji para bokosi la kiyi likasinthika na mawoko.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP kusangika kwa matenda: wakuwoneseska vigaŵa vyakupeleka kiyi vyakutali ivyo vilipo, wakuwoneseska mtundu wa chikalata cha chiphaso cha TEE, na kulongora umo chida cha KmInstallKeybox chikuŵira. Kusintha kanthu yayi — kuwona umo chipangizo chikuŵira.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine cheke (kuŵazga-pekha): kuwoneska Widevine vimanyikwiro vya msinkhu (L1/L3) kufuma ku dumpsys, DRM (IDM) kiyi-fayilo kuŵapo, na katundu wakukhwaskana na dongosolo. Kusintha kanthu yayi.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Fixes attestation issues when the automatic pass fails. Every run prints a clear success/failure line.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Handles the hard cases and takes longer. A clear result appears at the end.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Kuŵikaso GMS: kuwuskapo Play Store na Google mauteŵeti (GMS+GSF) data na kuyambiskaso chipangizo mwachindunji. Pakuti kukhozgera kwakujikuzga pera — kukukhwaska yayi vithuzithuzi panji mafayilo ghinu.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: checks the RKP certificate attestation state of the device and resets the attestation properties if needed. Does not touch user data.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER kunozga: kunozga Google ndondomeko ya mauteŵeti (SOTER) nkhani zakukhwaskana na kukhozgera chipangizo. Kugwiriskira ncito pa vipangizo vinyake ivyo vikuthemba pa SOTER m’malo mwa Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Apply PIF: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh force. Applies the selected fingerprint (local/advanced) and updates the pif.prop/pif.json files. A clear result appears in the log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF cheke: yikulongora umo injini yikuŵikika, mafayilo gha vimanyikwiro vya minwe (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), na vikuni. Chekani waka — yikusintha kanthu yayi.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Fetches the latest Canary Engine release to ensure compatibility with the mandatory RKP certificates (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: checks the TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), the keybox files (active vs user), the real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Diagnostic display only.
strings.panelKbSlots: 🔐 Malo gha bokosi la kiyi (la pulayimale / sekondare)
strings.hintKbSlots: Mutu uwu ukulaŵilira malo ghaŵiri gha kiyibosi: ghakwamba (ghakupatulika, ghakufumiskikapo yayi) na ghachiŵiri (ghakusungamo). Tab iyi yikulongora kuti ni malo wuli agho ghakugwira ntchito, kusintha ivyo mukutemwa, panji kukhozgera sekondare ku pulayimale pa pempho lakumanyikwa makora — na backups na log yose.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: checks the TEE key import, the library injection inside keystore2, the revocation status (CRL), the protection-list coverage and the RKP state. Read-only — it changes nothing.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Mndandanda wa chitetezo ukupangikaso kufuma ku pulogiramu yiliyose iyo yaŵikika.
• Layer yakukolerana ya custom-ROM yikuŵikikaso.
• Bokosi la kiyi ilo likugwira ntchito likuŵikikaso.
#• 0 restarted.

Palije chinthu icho chikufumiskikapo ndipo bokosi la kiyi lakwamba likukhwaskika yayi.

Kulutilira?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: shows the state of the primary and secondary slots and switches the preference between them. The primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) is always protected and never wiped. Promoting the secondary to primary requires explicit confirmation.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Kulimbikiska malo ghachiŵiri ku pulayimale:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml yikuŵa chigaŵa cha pulayimale.
• Pulayimale iyo yilipo sono yikusungika nga ni backup pambere yindaŵikike pa malo ghake.
• Palije icho chikufumiskikapo — ntchito yikuweleraso.5##0
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Fumiskanipo malo ghachiŵiri:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ghazamufumiskikapo.
• Malo ghakwamba ghakukhwaskika yayi.

Kulutilira?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (new in v3.17):

• Checks the current keybox against the Google revocation list (CRL).
• Tries multiple sources until a clean keybox is found.
• Automatic backup + restarts Google services.

⚠️ Needs internet (1-3 min). Continue?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Kutora bokosi la kiyi kufuma pa intaneti:

• Kukopera bokosi la kiyi lakuzomerezgeka na kulikhozgera.
• Kuŵikika kwamuyirayira (kuweleraso yayi pa boot).

⚠️ Kukukhumbikwira intaneti (mpaka 1 min). Lutilila?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Kuperekaso RKP makiyi:

• Palije data panji mafayilo gha bokosi la makiyi agho ghakufumiskikapo.
• Kuyambiskaso foni pamanyuma.

Kulutilira?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Kunozga kwakukwana:

• Kuperekaso RKP + kuyambiskaso Google mauteŵeti.
• Chipangizo chikuyambaso mwaŵene (palije icho chikufumiskikapo).

Kulutilira?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Yambiskaniso Google mauteŵeti:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — yambiskaniso pera.
• Palije ico cikufumiskikapo ndipo muzamufumiskikapo yayi.
• Chipangizo chikuyambaso mwaŵene.#000#65
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Kuchichizga kuperekaso (Red Magic):

• Kwa vipangizo ivyo vikuleka kupulikiska bokosi la makiyi ilo ladontha.
• Vikugwira ntchito nangauli makiyi ghali makora.
• Palije data iyo yikufumiskikapo.

Lutilirani?
strings.confirmCertify:
Kuchichizga Play Store chiphaso:

• Kuwuskapo waka cache ya Sitolo — akaunti yinu njambura kukhwaskika.
• Yambiskaniso, ndipo julani Sitolo.

Lutilirani?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER kunozga:

• Kuyambiskaso ntchito ya vendor.soter.
• Kuwuskapo SOTER data ya seva pera.

Kulutilira?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Gwiliskiranipo chimanyikwiro cha minwe (PIF):

• Kusintha custom.pif.prop na kuŵika mu nthowa ya injini.
• Kukhumbikwira kuyambaso pamanyuma.

Kulutilira?
strings.confirmCanary:
Kusintha kwa chimanyikwiro cha Canary:

• Kukopera chimanyikwiro cha Canary chasonosono kufuma ku Google.
• Kukoleska chigaŵa cha chivikiliro + kuyambiskaso ntchito za Google (palije kupukuta).

⚠️ Min.3). Lutilila?
